recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed unless a future work group decision changes where subscription error details are carried.
issue_request: FHIR-39036 was a Published/Persuasive R5 correction for the Subscription artifact. It reported stale subscription error-handling prose naming removed Subscription.error and requested references to SubscriptionStatus.error instead, with the client-add-errors sentence removed because clients do not write SubscriptionStatus.error.
initial_application: The issue was applied by commit fc98efc7de862cf3ac1b1b9d59a8e3f00d727094, which replaced the stale Subscription.error paragraph in source/subscriptions.html with wording that communicates errors via SubscriptionStatus.error, mentions notifications and the $status operation, and drops the client-add-errors warning.
additional_context: FHIR-27129 is the modeling background that moved Subscription.error to SubscriptionStatus.error. source/fhir.ini actively includes subscription, subscriptionstatus, and subscriptiontopic resources in the build; its only remaining Subscription.error text is in [r4-r6-changes] migration metadata, not current normative subscription prose or the current Subscription StructureDefinition. FHIR-I January 2023 WGM minutes record FHIR-39036 as will update documentation with an 11-0-0 vote. Zulip and Confluence searches found no later conflicting decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/subscriptions.html already states that errors a server wishes to expose are communicated via SubscriptionStatus.error, and source/subscriptionstatus/structuredefinition-SubscriptionStatus.xml defines SubscriptionStatus.error as the current target element.
